## Self-review checklist

Since this is an individual project, complete this checklist yourself
before merging, as a substitute for independent peer review.

- [ ] Code builds with `npm run build` and runs locally
- [ ] Meets the acceptance criteria of the linked issue
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with no errors
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes and coverage has not regressed
- [ ] New/changed logic has accompanying tests
- [ ] No obvious code duplication introduced
- [ ] Public functions have JSDoc comments
- [ ] Commit messages are descriptive and reference this issue
- [ ] README/docs updated if behaviour or setup changed
